title: Wavefield
logline: An overlapping luminous structure approaches an abstract detector. Six regular clicks grow from distant ripples to a sharp final tick, disappearance, a single point, and white.
overall: Published at the director-supplied URL. The release is the 24-second v4-4k finish, with the gentler opening, colored convergence and sharp detector ticks. Publication is user-confirmed; the local master hash does not identify the platform transcode.
next: Published. Preserve the final 4K master, original sources, calculation snapshots and revision history in the verified archive.

decisions.title: Pure abstraction and agent-selected pairs
decisions.detail: Director: All approved. Proceed at your own discretion through all six milestones. Definitely compute the overlapping wave fields.

decisions.title: Earlier approach and a single intersection
decisions.detail: Director: I like it. Spend less time at the beginning, get closer earlier, be super zoomed in to a single intersection before the final click, show more collapsing into it and vanishing, and add more visuals and colors to the ripples.

decisions.title: A gentler opening push-in
decisions.detail: Director: Maybe a little slower push-in at the beginning. By about a third.

decisions.title: Sharper detector ticks
decisions.detail: Director: Looking good. One last request: make the detector noise less booming and much sharper, like a click. Closer to a clock tick than a drum.

decisions.title: Publication and closeout
decisions.detail: Director supplied the YouTube publication URL and requested the post-publication process.

log.text: Production begins from the approved concept. Native draft planned; title provisional.
M01: selected A. The elongated shell has the clearest hollow diagonal seam and three large folds to track through the approach.
M02: selected A. The left petal opens while the original seam stays recognizable; dark seams provide a useful counterpart to the luminous ribs.
M03: selected B. The central passage widens without losing the lower folded petal; stronger depth provides the route for the approach.
M04: selected B. The broad lower fold opens further and the central void becomes a passage, with cleaner continuity than the small fragmented folds in A.
M05: selected A. The opening left fold broadens the structure and the high central rib carries the increasing tension while preserving the selected anatomy.
M06: selected A. The extended foreground petal and clean continuous ribs carry maximum tension with the strongest continuity into the final approach.
Native draft completed and inspected. Numerical verification, source lineage, encoded picture and audio checks passed. Calculation notebook retained alongside the status page.
Revision v2 begins from the director's notes. Earlier camera approach, tracked junction, converging wave packets and stronger chromatic ripples; existing source images and click timing retained.

Native v2 completed and frame-inspected. Camera reaches scale 3.3 by four seconds and 42 before the final click; secondary strands and inward packets vanish into the same junction. Soundtrack packet and decoded-sample hashes match v1. Numerical, export and project-analysis checks passed.
Revision v3 begins: camera growth runs at two thirds of v2 through the opening, then eases back to v2 at frame 250. The later picture and soundtrack will be retained.

Native v3 completed and frame-inspected. Opening camera growth is two thirds of v2 through three seconds and eases back to the prior move at frame 250. All later frames and the entire soundtrack match v2 exactly; native and project-analysis checks passed.
Sound-only revision v4 begins: reduce the detector to dry, clock-like ticks while retaining the six onsets and all v3 picture frames.

Native v4 completed: sharp mechanical detector ticks replace the bass resonator and long echoes. The final tick is fully dry. All picture frames and timestamps match v3; six onset samples and the existing quiet field-air stem are preserved. Native signal and project-analysis checks passed.
Authorized 4K finishing begins from v4. A local Lanczos upscale preserves the existing picture content; the maintained finisher will retain the exact edit and detector soundtrack.

Authorized 4K master completed from a verified lossless Lanczos counterpart using the maintained finisher. The same 720-frame edit and complete v4 soundtrack are retained. Native decode, full-frame comparisons, timestamp and sound identity checks passed. Draft publication text is included.
Director confirmed publication of the delivered 4K finish. Exact user-edited wording and credits are preserved; publication does not replace historical listening or semantic-review states.
